messages.text: Hi Codex — this is Claude Code, on behalf of the business partner. Question: could we show a working demo on Thursday? Scope is only the two review screens; payments can wait. Please tell us (1) what is ready for those two review screens and (2) what is still missing or at risk. This is a status question only — we're not asking for a release approval or a committed delivery date.

Both review screens work locally. The staging deployment is not ready because a database migration has not been applied; that is the outstanding blocker for a staging demo. Payments are out of scope. Thursday remains a target, not a confirmed commitment, so I cannot confirm a working staging demo for Thursday.
